item.title: Two Galesburg men convicted of drug trafficking by federal jury
item.description: Juan Pablo Garcia and Edgar Calderon were convicted of trafficking cocaine and methamphetamine and will be sentenced on June 15 in Rock Island.

item.title: Peoria startup to showcase security technology at South by Southwest
item.description: ShotHawk, a Peoria-based startup, will be showcasing its security technology at South by Southwest in Austin, Texas, which is designed to help deter violent threats and give people more time to escape dangerous situations.

item.title: Sleep experts explain how losing an hour affects your body and mind
item.description: Daylight Saving Time begins Sunday morning, resulting in the loss of an hour of sleep, which can affect the body and mind, but most people adjust within a few days with good sleep habits and gradual schedule shifts.

item.title: Peoria man faces 30 years in prison for January 2024 shooting
item.description: Kevin L. Foster, 38, of Peoria, IL, has been charged with aggravated battery and possession of a weapon by a felon in connection with a January 2024 shooting at KG's Bar, and faces up to 30 years in prison if convicted.

item.title: 'East to Par-A-Dice': East Peoria mayor unveils new motto in State of the City address
item.description: Mayor John Kahl of East Peoria discussed the city's development successes, proposed budget, and the Par-A-Dice Casino Hotel investment in his State of the City address.

item.title: Normal's underpass project faces delay as contractor pulls out
item.description: The Town of Normal is now working with P.J. Hoerr to complete the long-awaited underpass project in Uptown Normal, after the original contractor Millstone-Weber pulled out due to timeline and requirement concerns.

item.title: Bloomington's new youth arts program celebrates diversity
item.description: Threshold to Hope in Bloomington has launched the Color Our Stories project, a multicultural art and diversity program funded by the Healing Illinois Grant, to provide children from low-income areas with a safe space to explore their heritage through art.

item.title: TRAFFIC ALERT: Overturned semi closes part of I-74
item.description: An overturned semi truck has closed part of Interstate 74 near Carlock, IL, resulting in injuries and traffic diversions.

item.title: WATCH LIVE: Chief Meteorologist Chris Yates is live with weather updates
item.description: PEORIA, Ill. (WMBD) -- With storms moving into the area, WMBD Chief Meteorologist Chris Yates is live with all the updates.

item.title: Bradley outlasts Valpo in 2OT in MVC Tournament
item.description: ST. LOUIS (WMBD/WYZZ) -- Bradley is advancing to the semifinals of the Missouri Valley Conference Tournament after a double overtime thriller. Jaquan Johnson scored 18 as did Ahmet Jonovic as Bradley outlasted Valparaiso, 90-84, in an MVC quarterfinal at Enterprise Center.
